questions.stem: 氣候難民所失去的不只是家園，還有他們最珍惜的文化傳統與社群。
questions.answer: What climate refugees lose is not only their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities that they cherish most.
accepted_answers: What climate refugees have lost is not just their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities they treasure the most.
What climate refugees lose is not merely their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities that they value most.

questions.stem: 無論最後在哪裡落腳，這些難民的收入往往還不到當地居民平均薪資的一半。
questions.answer: No matter where they finally settle down, these refugees often earn less than half the average salary of local residents.
accepted_answers: No matter where they eventually settle, the income of these refugees is often less than half the average wage of local residents.
No matter where they end up settling, what these refugees earn is often less than half the average pay of local people.

patterns: 倍數比較（less than half the + N）

1.explanation_zh: 「氣候難民所失去的」是整個句子的主詞，英文用 what 引導的名詞子句 What climate refugees lose（＝the things that climate refugees lose），what 子句當主詞，動詞用單數 is。「不只是…，還有…」用 not only … but also …，前後都接名詞，保持對稱。「他們最珍惜的」修飾「文化傳統與社群」，改成後位關係子句 that they cherish most（most 修飾動詞，也可寫 the most）。
1.strategy_zh: 「…所＋動詞＋的」當主詞時，先想 What + S + V；「最＋動詞」用 V + (the) most，放在子句句尾。
hints: 切成四段：氣候難民所失去的／不只是家園，還有／他們最珍惜的／文化傳統與社群
標的詞彙：climate（氣候）、refugee（難民）、lose（失去）、home（家園）、tradition（傳統）、community（社群）、cherish（珍惜）
句型框架：What + S + V + is not only A but also B + (that) + S + V + most

2.explanation_zh: 「無論在哪裡…」用 No matter where + S + V（＝Wherever …），子句用直述句語序；「落腳」是定居 settle (down)。「這些難民的收入」可以讓人當主詞 these refugees earn …，也可以用名詞 the income of these refugees is …。「還不到…的一半」是倍數比較，寫成 less than half + the + 名詞 + of …（half 後面直接接 the average salary），英文一定要有動詞 earn 或 is。
evidence: 還不到當地居民平均薪資的一半
2.strategy_zh: 「無論＋疑問詞」→ No matter + wh- + S + V；「是…的一半／兩倍」→ half／twice + the + N + of …，或 half as much as …。
hints: 切成四段：無論最後在哪裡落腳／這些難民的收入往往／還不到／當地居民平均薪資的一半
標的詞彙：settle（定居、落腳）、refugee（難民）、income／earn（收入）、half（一半）、average（平均的）、salary（薪資）、local（當地的）、resident（居民）
句型框架：No matter where + S + V, S + often earn + less than half + the + N + of …

references: What climate refugees lose is not only their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities that they cherish most.
What climate refugees have lost is not just their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities they treasure the most.
What climate refugees lose is not merely their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities that they value most.

patterns.label_zh: what 引導的名詞子句當主詞（所…的事物）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「…所失去的」整段是主詞，要用 what 引導名詞子句；少了 what，句子同時有 lose 和 is 兩個動詞卻沒有連接。
難民泛指一群人，用複數 refugees，動詞 lose 不加 s。

accepted: is not only their homes but also
is not just their homes but also
is not merely their homes but also

common_errors.wrong: is not only their homes, also
common_errors.right: is not only their homes but also
common_errors.explanation_zh: not only 要和 but also 配對；「還有」不能只在逗號後面寫 also。

common_errors.wrong: is not only their family but also
common_errors.right: is not only their homes but also
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「家園」指居住的家和土地，用 homes（或 homeland）；family 是家人。
「最」修飾動詞用 most（或 the most）；mostly 是「大多、主要地」。
that 已經代替受詞（傳統與社群），子句裡不可再寫 them。
修飾名詞要用形容詞 cultural；culture 是名詞。
「社群」指彼此有連結、一起生活的一群人，用 community；society 是整個社會。

traps.literal_error: What climate refugees lose is not only their homes but also their culture and groups they love most.
traps.explanation_zh: 「社群」不是隨意的 group，而是一起生活、互相扶持的 community；「文化傳統」要寫成 cultural traditions（形容詞＋名詞）。

traps.literal_error: Climate refugees lost is not only their homes but also …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「…所失去的」直接當主詞，英文不能拿動詞當主詞，要改成名詞子句 What climate refugees lose。

bonus.text: Not only do climate refugees lose their homes, but they also lose the cultural traditions and communities they hold most dear.
bonus.explanation_zh: Not only 放句首時，後面要倒裝（do + 主詞 + 原形動詞）；hold … dear（珍視）比 cherish 更有文采。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「他們最珍惜的文化傳統與社群」中文修飾語在前，英文先寫名詞，再用後位關係子句 the cultural traditions and communities that they cherish most；主詞「氣候難民所失去的」整段改成 what 子句。

references: No matter where they finally settle down, these refugees often earn less than half the average salary of local residents.
No matter where they eventually settle, the income of these refugees is often less than half the average wage of local residents.
No matter where they end up settling, what these refugees earn is often less than half the average pay of local people.

patterns.label_zh: 讓步：無論在哪裡（no matter where）
patterns.frame: No matter where + S + V, S + V …
S + earn + less than half + the + N + of …

accepted: No matter where they finally settle down
No matter where they eventually settle
No matter where they end up settling

common_errors.wrong: No matter where do they finally settle down
common_errors.right: No matter where they finally settle down
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter where 後面用直述句語序（主詞＋動詞），不要用疑問句的 do 倒裝。

common_errors.wrong: No matter where they finally drop their feet
common_errors.right: No matter where they finally settle down
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「落腳」是定居、安頓下來，用 settle (down)；不要逐字翻。

accepted: the income of these refugees is often
what these refugees earn is often

common_errors.explanation_zh: 用動詞 earn 時主詞是人（these refugees）；用名詞 income 時寫 the income of these refugees is …，兩種寫法不要混在一起。

common_errors.wrong: the income of these refugees are often
common_errors.right: the income of these refugees is often
common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞的核心是 income（不可數），動詞用 is。
「還不到一半」是在比較數量，用 less than half；not reach half 是逐字直譯，而且少了 be 動詞或主要動詞。
語序是 less than half（少於一半），不要照中文順序寫成 half less than。

parts.zh: 當地居民平均薪資的一半
accepted: the average salary of local residents
the average wage of local residents
the average pay of local people
the average income of local residents

common_errors.wrong: the average salary of the local resident
common_errors.right: the average salary of local residents
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「當地居民」泛指一群人，用複數 local residents。

common_errors.right: the average salary of local residents
common_errors.explanation_zh: 所有格要加 s 的撇號（local residents' average salary），或改用 the average salary of local residents。

traps.literal_error: No matter where they finally drop their feet, these refugees …
traps.explanation_zh: 「落腳」是安頓、定居，英文用 settle (down)；照字面寫 drop their feet 讀者看不懂。

traps.literal_error: No matter where they settle down, these refugees' income often not reach half of …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「還不到一半」沒有「是」，英文卻一定要有動詞：these refugees earn less than half …／their income is less than half …。

bonus.text: Wherever they eventually settle, these refugees rarely earn even half the average wage of local residents.
bonus.explanation_zh: Wherever 等於 no matter where，更簡潔；rarely … even half（很少能達到一半）用否定副詞表達「還不到」，語氣更強。

2.restructuring_zh: 「這些難民的收入…還不到…的一半」可以把名詞「收入」改成動詞：these refugees earn less than half …，比 the income of these refugees is … 簡潔；「平均薪資」直接放在 half the 後面。

1.translation: What climate refugees lose is not only their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities that they cherish most.
1.explanation_zh: 「所失去的」以 what 名詞子句當主詞；「不只是……還有……」用 not only... but also... 對稱連接兩個名詞；「最珍惜的」以關係子句 that they cherish most 修飾；一般性陳述用現在式。

2.translation: No matter where these refugees eventually settle, their income is often less than half of the average salary of local residents.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論在哪裡」用 No matter where 引導讓步子句；「最後」譯 eventually；「還不到……的一半」用 less than half of；主詞換成 these refugees 放在讓步子句，主要子句用 their income 避免代名詞前指。

issues_zh: 建議（不影響判定）：第 1 部分可補「No matter where these refugees eventually settle」（讓步子句直接用名詞、主要子句用 their income），第 4 部分可補「less than half of the average salary…」（half 後加 of 也正確）。
建議（不影響判定）：第 4 部分的 zh「當地居民平均薪資的一半」含「一半」，但 half 是算在第 3 部分「還不到」，改卷時要留意不要重複扣分。

1.translation: Climate refugees have lost not only their homes but also the cultural traditions and communities that they cherish the most.
1.explanation_zh: 「失去的不只是……還有……」用 not only … but also 對等連接兩個受詞；失去是已發生且影響延續的事，用現在完成式；「最珍惜的」譯成 cherish the most 的關係子句。

2.translation: No matter where they end up settling, these refugees often earn less than half of the average wage of local residents.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論……」用 no matter where 引導讓步副詞子句；「最後落腳」用 end up settling；「不到一半」是 less than half；「收入」直接用動詞 earn，句子較自然。

issues_zh: 我的譯文是主動句 Climate refugees have lost not only their homes but also …，自然又正確；但參考譯文與各部分 accepted 都綁死 what 子句（What … lose is not only …），中文「所失去的不只是…還有…」沒有強制 what 子句，標的句型 NCL 沒有被引出。
第 1、2 部分（氣候難民所失去的／不只是家園，還有）都要求 What 子句加 is，改寫成 have lost not only … but also 的學生會同時丟掉兩個部分；建議 accepted 補上 Climate refugees have lost/lose not only their homes but also，或把標的句型改成中文較能引出的句型。
